fallback: This task was continued by a new AI because {reason}.
reason.context_missing: no saved context existed for the earlier session
reason.context_invalid: the saved context was damaged or could not be verified
reason.context_unavailable: the saved context could not be retrieved
reason.version_incompatible: the saved context belongs to an incompatible version
reason.restore_failed: restoring it on the VM failed
reason.unknown: the earlier context could not be restored
restored: Continued with the full context of the original session
restored.workspace_omitted: Continued with the full conversation; the workspace was too large and was not restored.
restored.workspace_partial: Continued with the full conversation; the workspace was only partly restored.
interrupted: Interrupted – the device has been unreachable since {time}. The task continues once the device is back or another suitable device can take it over.
failover: Continued after a device failure (from the last saved checkpoint)
